CustomField.description: BOPI-460 This field is used on the Quote Advanced Approval email templates and Quote Document to show a single column with a price regardless of the product Rate Type and Usage Type
CustomField.formula: IF( ISPICKVAL(Rate_Type__c, "Fixed"), TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode) & " " & TEXT(ROUND(NS_Billing_Price__c, 2)) & IF( MOD(ROUND(NS_Billing_Price__c, 2), 1) = 0, ".00", "" ), CASE( Usage_Type__c, "Percent", IF( AND( Quoted_Usage_Percent__c < 0.01, Quoted_Usage_Percent__c > 0 ), "0", "" ) & TEXT(ROUND(Quoted_Usage_Percent__c * 100, 2)) & IF( MOD(ROUND(Quoted_Usage_Percent__c * 100, 2), 1) = 0, ".00", IF( MOD(ROUND(Quoted_Usage_Percent__c * 1000, 2), 1) = 0, "0", "" ) ) & "%", "Amount", TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode) & " " & IF( AND( Quoted_Usage_Amt__c < 1, Quoted_Usage_Amt__c > 0 ), "0", "" ) & TEXT(ROUND(Quoted_Usage_Amt__c, 2)) & IF( MOD(ROUND(Quoted_Usage_Amt__c, 2), 1) = 0, ".00", IF( MOD(ROUND(Quoted_Usage_Amt__c * 10, 2), 1) = 0, "0", "" ) ), "Both", TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode) & " 0.00", TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode) & " 0.00" ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Will show the usage rate if the product rate type is usage based or a price amount if the product rate type is fixed
CustomField.label: Price
